rationale: The publisher identifies Shiraz thesis project 96-16241 and the accepted manuscript posting date. The fatigue analysis underlying the abstract and NICE estimates, actual ingredient intake and canola refining remain unverified.

An adjusted numeric aggregate PRO-PD association was confirmed. The overlapping 2024 heatmap still supplies no item-level estimate or oil grade. A dataset application route is documented, and the underlying item data were not retrieved.

The osteoarthritis registry has no posted arm-level fatigue results. The independent EVACUR protocol specifies FACIT-F in systemic lupus under a mixed intervention without isolating ground Nigella seed.

The registry lists planned Epworth sleepiness but has no results. The Dretsch author abstract gives a corn-oil ethyl-ester placebo without a verified exact registration or reported Epworth arm comparison.

The COPD trial registry specifies 3 g/day of soy–corn blend. The final abstract and supplement specify 2 g/day, with no available numeric gait or balance table. A separate culinary refined-corn result remains unavailable.

The official cranberry-juice registration remains recruiting as of the November 25 posted update and gives cognitive outcomes without a posted bradykinesia result. The rat paper remains at exact abstract depth for coordination and preparation.

The original metadata date the fly study to November 26, 2024 online before the 2025 issue. Published fly climbing direction is documented, while cooking, numerical groups and overlap remain unverified.

Full oral distilled fruit-oil rat results, independent injected mouse-extract results and the closest human ground-spice BDI-II trial were assessed. The human comparison is inconclusive. The animal results have limited transfer to clinical Parkinson depression. The primary cultural fieldwork records spice use without a matched depressive response. The published verdict is Unknown.
